liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (3 reviews): Santana and Cipollina trade dueling guitar solos with Garcia, who stomps on the old standard; Crowd claps along with the drums, then Carlos bursts in [15][19][21]
- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): Outstanding version; Jerry parts the waters midway through; Phil's thumping and vibe-laying make it a standout for a mixed year [15][19]
- **Bridging the Gap** (2 other sources): The only known Grateful Dead performance of Bridging the Gap; Finale with everyone on stage [1][5]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): A few minutes in, the band seems energized and Jerry's playing is fanning beautifully; the energy continues afterward [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bridging the Gap**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Amazing Grace**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [22]
- **crowd - thank you**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-01-13.158146.gems.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 14 songs; 102 min [1]
- **gd1980-01-13.170738.fm.master.reel.menke.miller.flac24**: FM broadcast; 13 songs; 115 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1980-01-13.170773.fm.master.reel.menke.miller.flac1648**: FM broadcast; 13 songs; 115 min [4]
- **gd1980-01-13.sbd.miller.106517.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 103 min; rated 4.25/5 by 12 [5]
- **gd80-01-13.sbd.popi.6145.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 90 min; rated 4.2/5 by 20 [7]. Said about its sound: The tape has a big dropout near the beginning of Jack Straw; Heavy crackle begins around 6:30 into track 2 and lasts through much of that song; Track 4 has a click about a minute in, followed by more crackle and a dropout [12][13][16][18]

## Around the show

- John Cipollina and Carlos Santana join on Not Fade Away and Sugar Magnolia; Greg Errico joins on U.S. Blues [10]
- An older bootleg opens with Bobby thanking Joan Baez for organizing the benefit [14]
- Between Franklin's Tower and Minglewood, Bobby announced it was Billy's 45th birthday, though Billy was actually 33 [14]
- Joan Baez, Mickey Thomas and the Wilson brothers sing on Bridging the Gap and Amazing Grace; Pete Sears and Craig Chaquico play guitar on Bridging the Gap [1]
- Santana and Cipollina play on tracks 10-11, Errico on drums on track 13, and Joan Baez on tracks 14-15 [3]
- The Beach Boys sing vocals on Land Of A Thousand Dances [3]
- Santana and Cipollina are on tracks 10-11, Greg Errico on drums on track 13, and Joan Baez on tracks 14-15 [4]
- The show breaks from the usual two-set format and features many guests [10]
- Brent has several highlights, unlike many shows from his first year when he is mixed low [18]
- Fierce Minglewood, compared with the Rochester opener on 9/2 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-01-13.158146.gems.flac1648**: taped by Augustus Owsley Stanley III; transferred by Transferred (Nov 2021) and mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Maxell MX90 cassette from Bear via Jamie Waddell [1]. Also: Source 106517 is upsampled to 96k; it aired on Dead Legs Program 05 and was shared in September 2022 [1]
- **gd1980-01-13.170738.fm.master.reel.menke.miller.flac24**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Recorded and Transferred by Bob Menke Mastered by Charlie Miller  March 30, 2025; source: FM (KMEL-FM) > Reel Master (Technics 1506 1/4 track 10inch 7.5ips) [3]. Also: This is a 24-bit FLAC from an FM master reel [3]
- **gd1980-01-13.170773.fm.master.reel.menke.miller.flac1648**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by ecorded and Transferred by Bob Menke Mastered by Charlie Miller  March 30, 2025; source: FM (KMEL-FM) > Reel Master (Technics 1506 1/4 track 10inch 7.5ips) [4]. Also: Converted from 24-bit/96kHz to 16-bit/48kHz in Foobar2000 with dBpoweramp/SSRC by Tyler/MrCompletely [4]
- **gd1980-01-13.sbd.miller.106517.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat [5]. Also: Soundboard source from the KSAN San Francisco FM broadcast [5]
- **gd80-01-13.sbd.popi.6145.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
